transfer.stem: 换成日出、修卖自行车和应季水果，哪组英文保留了三条新信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
公园在日出半小时后开放。这家店既修自行车，也卖自行车。我们在市场买应季水果。
词语提示：sunrise 日出；opens 开放；bicycles 自行车；fruit 水果。

options.text: The park opens half an hour before sunrise. This shop repairs bicycles as well as selling them. We buy seasonal fruit at the market.
The park opens half an hour after sunrise. This shop only sells bicycles. We buy seasonal fruit at the market.
The park opens half an hour after sunrise. This shop repairs bicycles as well as selling them. We buy seasonal fruit at the market.

answer.display: The park opens half an hour after sunrise. This shop repairs bicycles as well as selling them. We buy seasonal fruit at the market.

explanation.strategy: 重新核对日出后的时间、两项服务和购买的商品；不套用上一句的日落与蔬菜。

steps.text: 日出半小时后开放：opens half an hour after sunrise。
steps.reason: after是之后；half an hour是30分钟。本题说开放，不是关园。

steps.text: 既修自行车也卖自行车：repairs bicycles as well as selling them。
steps.reason: them指bicycles；only sells会漏掉维修这项服务。

steps.text: 在市场买应季水果：buy seasonal fruit at the market。
steps.reason: seasonal是应季，不能换成out of season反季。

distractors.reason: before把日出之后改成日出之前。
only sells只保留销售，漏掉维修。
out of season把应季水果改成反季水果。

explanation.pitfall: 日出、开放、自行车和水果都是新条件；要重新读，不能照抄旧句。
